maddeler.e:
انفطروا (form VII)
# اِنْفَطَرُوا (infaṭarū) /in.fa.tˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْفَطَرَ (infaṭara)
# اِنْفَطِرُوا (infaṭirū) /in.fa.tˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْفَطَرَ (infaṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
